A field note on the small decisions that make financial systems dependable when everything around them is changing.

Reliable systems are usually built from unglamorous choices: clear ownership, useful dashboards, and a rollback plan that has actually been rehearsed.

Some seasons are for shipping. Some are for noticing what the shipping was supposed to make possible.

I am learning to leave room for a life that is not measured only by output, milestones, or the next thing to opt.
